applicability_note: The control applies to all systems, but the reviewed provisions are specific to high-risk AI systems under the EU AI Act.
challenge_comment: The mapping is partially correct as Articles 9, 13, and 15 support the testing of accuracy, but they do not cover all aspects of the control statement, specifically hallucination and repeatability. Article 26(5) is incorrectly mapped as it pertains to post-deployment monitoring, not testing. The mapping should be refined to focus on provisions that explicitly require testing for the full scope of the control statement.
